La legge protegge chi lo subisce: dai 14: In Italy the law protects the person targeted: from 14 you can ask for content to be removed yourself, and every school has a contact person.
La legge 71/2017, aggiornata dalla legge: In Italy, Law 71/2017, updated by Law 70/2024, provides for a contact person in every school, a request to the site or social network to remove content and, if it doesn’t reply within 24 hours or act within 48, to the Data Protection Authority, and a formal police warning for anyone over 14.
Dal 2025 il 114 Emergenza Infanzia offre: Since 2025 the 114 child emergency line also offers first psychological and legal support to people targeted by bullying and cyberbullying (Legislative Decree 99/2025).
